summary: (spec fidelity) Two Then steps go unasserted: search_trace_04 never checks that nothing apart from the index is written, and search_query_01 never checks that equal scores are ordered by id (its two hits have different scores). The reviewer checked the first by hand (a search/trace run wrote only .canon/index/search.db and .canon/index/.gitignore), and the code orders by `score, n.id`. Blast radius: none; this is test coverage only.
